name: How long do accessible home modification projects take?

mainEntity.name: How long do accessible home modification projects take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of accessible home modification projects depends on their scope. Simple installations like grab bars can take a few hours. More extensive projects, such as a full bathroom remodel or ramp construction, might take several days to a few weeks. Major structural changes or multi-room renovations could extend to several months. We provide a clear timeline estimate after the project scope is defined.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies. Simple tasks take hours, while extensive renovations can range from days to several weeks or months. A timeline estimate is provided after scope definition.
